name: Food Collective Today
description: Tasks and events for Berkeley Student Food Collective shifts, connected to Airtable.

airtable_api_key.description: Your Airtable token. Copy it from your current app: Settings → Reveal Config Vars → airtable_api_key.

AIRTABLE_BASE_ID.description: Airtable base the app reads from.

AIRTABLE_TASKS_TABLE_ID.description: Tasks table (for the shift task banner).

AIRTABLE_SHIFT_TASK_VIEW.description: Optional. Name of the Airtable view whose top task shows as 'This shift's main task'. Leave blank to show the newest task from the last 12 hours.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the Admin settings page. A random one is made for you; find it later under Settings → Config Vars.

SECRET_KEY_BASE.description: Keeps logins secure. Made for you.

RAILS_SERVE_STATIC_FILES.description: Lets the app serve its own fonts, images and styles.

RAILS_LOG_TO_STDOUT.description: Sends logs to Heroku's log viewer.
